notes: Closes UX-24.5 together with the prior import, weekly, activity and Campaigns evidence. This is capability access and shared control/state-pattern acceptance; it does not pass all complete task-flow, browser, physical-device, accessibility or human-review gates.

Staff review used three real, disposable staff-upload assets in the isolated Juniper account. Approval converted the reviewed asset to an approved source; rejection removed the other two. A controlled refresh failure after successful rejection verified that the saved review is not repeated. All three temporary staff assets are removed.

Create staff link and Copy link were exercised against a local link; Copy reported Staff link copied. The revocation UI used a controlled 200 response to preserve earlier isolated staff-upload links. Existing expansion regressions verify actual revocation, ownership and staff-to-source conversion. No link was sent externally.

Batch generation states are response fixtures. All batch-create and retry POST requests were intercepted and never reached generation. Existing expansion tests cover real idempotency and retry-only-failed behavior with provider stubs. UI fixtures include queued, processing, partial, failed, ready and exhausted-retry states.

Earlier batch captures exposed unequal phone action heights and feedback above actions. Final failure/pending phone views demonstrate equal 61.1875px controls and 0px movement in document coordinates. The final 320px treatment stacks two readable 44px actions; use finalNarrowLayouts over the earlier 320px side-by-side row measurements. Other fresh views remain applicable.

The first intended partial upload became two successes because the next tool call arrived after the second request had captured the delay profile. It is recorded as upload-all-success, not partial-failure evidence. The subsequent partial test changed the profile in the same invocation immediately after the first request was observed: one saved file, one 503, then one successful same-file retry. Four temporary source uploads were removed.

Upload success wording was refined after the captured operation had stored its result; the retained success message in that earlier view says Upload review complete. Current code says Uploads complete. Saved originals are kept with this dish. The verified request/file outcomes are unchanged.

Native app inventory was unavailable, but the documented browser filechooser API successfully exercised real file selection. Resetting the automation session did not reset the browser or application data.
Only the Codex in-app browser was available, with engine/version unspecified. No Safari, Firefox, physical keyboard/safe-area or 200% text-size coverage is claimed here.

Final profile is empty, the response gateway is stopped, and the normal localhost:5173 preview is restored. No paid generation, purchase, production write, publication, deployment or outbound message occurred.
